name: check_draft_answers_against_inventory
description: Checks draft store-questionnaire answers against a build/data inventory string and flags common compliance traps: contradictions with planned markets, self-selected age ratings, "privacy policy not needed", absolute no-data claims, EN-only localisation, premature "ready to submit".

example.inventory: App "Mirror Marsh" single-player WebXR puzzle game. Local high-score table on device only; no accounts, no cloud, no analytics, no IAP. Being prepared for US, EU and Brazil store listings in English, German and Portuguese (BR). Ages 10+.

answers.text: We will select ESRB E10+, PEGI 12, and the lowest Brazil rating. No rating authority review needed.
We collect no personal data at all.
Privacy policy URL: Not needed since no data is collected.
GDPR: Does not apply — no EU users and no personal data.
LGPD: Not relevant; Brazil is not in the plan.
English copy will be shipped for all three regions; no translation needed.
Ready to submit. Owner only needs to click submit in the dashboard.
